asl_letter_A: Closed fist with four fingers curled short and thumb resting diagonally alongside them.
asl_letter_B: Flat hand, four fingers extended straight up together, thumb folded flat across the palm.

asl_letter_D: Index finger extended straight up, other three fingers curled into a round cluster touching the thumb.

asl_letter_I: Pinky finger extended straight up, other three fingers curled down with thumb tucked across them.
asl_letter_J: Pinky extended upward with other fingers curled -- the static starting handshape before J's traced motion.
